facts.text: Ramada cooking on Topper's stomach. We used a cast iron pan.
facts.why: In the bacon and eggs scene the food cooks on Ramada's belly, as the menu's own cue says. Topper's stomach is not used.
facts.fix: Eggs and bacon sizzling on Ramada's stomach. We used a cast iron pan.

vibe.verdict: The airline format fits a parody, but it reads as Airplane more than Top Gun and misses the best gags.
missing: Admiral Benson thanking Block for a stroganoff dinner that never happened (the base)
Dead Meat saluting in the credits (the end)
Topper melting an ice cube on Ramada's belly button (the bedroom)
Wash Out and his wall eye (the mission)
Kent Gregory blessing the romance (the finish)
Topper's father Buzz and the plane (flashback)
ideas: Swap 'Airbase rib eye, corn and slaw' note for 'Admiral Benson thanks everyone for dinner nobody had'.
Replace 'Airbase soft pretzels with beer cheese' with 'Beef stroganoff that never happened'.
Use a navy fighter jet styling for the page instead of the airline seat card.
Add 'Salute for Dead Meat' as the dessert note on the custard tarts.
